title: Ayro tawqe Albaabih Dacayri
intro: Qur'aanak addat, inkinki roocitte ardi bagul taturtam wale kee assakat le raat cabak. Inki tannah tan ximmooma, ginook baxsa le ximmooma fan gexe—ayro elle cultaah, elle cultaah, barrier isih chaos elle culta. Ta Yallih taama abeyna numuk teyni qagitaak gace waah yan amoytiinul tomcowwe. sidiica baxsale safaritteh addat, ta cankah hadaf qaddooweh. atu baxxaaqissam duuddaa aydaadi silaalak fanak ta aydaadih yan wanderer?
clues: Anu reeda yomcowweh suge Kaxxa Racmatta ardi bagul xiinisuh gersi num aracat haam duude wee gital.
Anu ayro korma fanah gexak, ayro elle cultah tan arac guffa haam fan, murky spring addat culteh tan arac gorrisak, wokkel yan mara ubleh.
Anu ayro mawqah exxal safar abeeh, ayro elle tawqe arac guffa haam fan, ayroytal elle tawqe arac gufam fan, Nanu elle faxximta gurral akah abne innah abne ummattal.
Anu too namma extreme point fanat safar abeeh, namma qaleeli fanat yan golo fanah gexak, yabti taqabih addat yan mara geyne.
Anu qaleel namma gibdi adaf geeh birti migda kee gural gufam kee ken fanat, ceenale gita. too ummatta yoo essertem adaf aggiluh uluuluka wadir yabbixe.
Anu inni rizqi beeh, excem: 'Barrier diggalsimta waqdi, tamah nee kee ta ummattah fanat qado baxsi akkele.' kee xagni uddur gufe wak, anu ubleh adaf ellecaboh yiddigille.

trial.answer: Yajuj kee Majuj ummattah birti adaf yaggileenim

location.answer: Namma qaleh fanal yan birti adaf.

outcome.answer: xagni uddur gufa wak adaf yiddigilleeh, uluuluka caxitteh

arabic: قَالُوا۟ يَـٰذَا ٱلْقَرْنَيْنِ إِنَّ يَأْجُوجَ وَمَأْجُوجَ مُفْسِدُونَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ فَهَلْ نَجْعَلُ لَكَ خَرْجًا عَلَىٰٓ أَن تَجْعَلَ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَهُمْ سَدًّۭا
verse: They said, "O Dhul-Qarnayn, indeed Gog and Magog are [great] corrupters in the land. So may we assign for you an expenditure that you might make between us and them a barrier?" (18:94)
